description: Source file implementing PlatformCapsData class with methods for retrieving device info via JSON-RPC calls, including model, device type, HDR capabilities, account ID, device ID, session token, experience, MAC address, and public IP; also includes RPC client management.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Class providing methods to retrieve platform capabilities and device information via JSON-RPC.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc
classes.description: Nested class managing JSON-RPC client interactions, including invoking methods and client proxy management.

methods.name: stringFromHex
methods.description: Converts a hex string to its ASCII representation.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::GetModel
methods.description: Retrieves device model information via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::GetDeviceType
methods.description: Retrieves device type, conditionally compiled based on ENABLE_COMMUNITY_DEVICE_TYPE.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::GetHDRCapability
methods.description: Retrieves HDR support standards as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::XCALSessionTokenAvailable
methods.description: Checks if session token is available.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::invoke
methods.description: Invokes a JSON-RPC method and returns the result.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::activate
methods.description: Activates a client proxy for a given callsign.

methods.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::getClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a client proxy for a callsign.
